harness_notes: Each task directory contains: spec.md, tests.py, solution.py.
solution.py is the REFERENCE solution used to verify the test set is internally consistent. The Phase 2 harness MUST NOT expose solution.py to the writer agent — it is ground truth, not input.

Writers see spec.md. Whether they also see tests.py is a design question (see SESSION 2 kickoff): showing tests = easier task, hiding tests = pure spec interpretation. Underspec tasks specifically require hiding the tests, otherwise the writer just reads off the answer.
tests.py imports `from solution import ...`. The harness should write the writer's attempt to solution.py in a sandboxed directory before running pytest.
humaneval_check_notes: These 4 tasks use HumanEval-shaped patterns. Before running Phase 2 evals, sanity-check that Sonnet 4.6 does NOT one-shot the full test set on these. If it does, modify spec or add edge cases. The 9 hand-authored tasks are less likely to be in training data but verify spot-checks anyway. Underspec tasks (012, 013) inherently can't be one-shotted because the spec is incomplete — but they should still be checked that the agent doesn't pattern-match to a well-known format set.
